title: Steam local client data
whyItMatters: Steam keeps cached client state and a DPAPI key under LocalAppData. It shows the account was signed in and games were installed.
notes: The main account files (loginusers.vdf, userdata) sit in the Steam install directory under Program Files, which has no root token; this rule covers only reachable LocalAppData state. Unconfirmed: custom install directories are not matched.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy any game saves kept only on this PC, since some titles do not use Steam Cloud.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Steam and remove this computer from your authorized devices in Steam Guard settings.
steps: On the Steam website, open Account Details, then Authorized Devices, and choose Sign out everywhere.
Uninstall Steam and delete the folder named in the plan.
cleanup.risk: Removes the local client state and cached sign-in from this PC. Games, licences and cloud saves stay with the Steam account.
